Khatam al-Anbiya statement: US B-2 Spirit bombers observed entering Iranian airspace from the south. Air defense radar detected aircraft over Bushehr province. Launch of standoff munitions detected. Intercept attempts underway over Bushehr and Fars provinces.

Witness reports from Ahvaz: Large explosions heard near IRGC positions on the outskirts of the city. Ambulances rushing toward impacted areas. Satellite phone footage shows smoke plume visible from center of Ahvaz. Military sources confirm strike on IRGC logistics depot.

IRGC Naval Forces: Witness reports of fast attack craft deploying from Bandar Abbas toward the Strait of Hormuz. Civilians report seeing small boats moving at high speed in formation. US Navy assets observed repositioning. Situation developing in the eastern Persian Gulf.

Artesh statement: Iranian Army artillery units shelled US positions at Camp Buehring, Kuwait from launch positions near Abadan. Witnesses in Abadan reported artillery fire throughout the night. US Central Command confirms indirect fire impacts on base perimeter. No US casualties reported.

Chinese satellite imagery confirmed a new impact at Muwaffaq Salti Air Base, Jordan. Strike occurred between July 22-23. Iran targeted AN/TPY-2 radar and a Patriot system at the base. Satellites show damage to a newly built area of the base (built around April 2026).
Iranian short-range ballistic missile (Fateh-110) directly targeted the US Fifth Fleet headquarters in Bahrain. Video shows the impact — missile was not intercepted by American Patriot systems.
Reports of missile launches from Yemen towards Saudi Arabia. Rasd Akhbar Shehaba reporting: "The Yemeni response enters into force".
Wave of missiles launching from Iran. Followed by reports of missile launches toward US occupation bases in West Asia.
Warplanes flying in Kuwaiti airspace. Air activity reported across the region.
Satellite imagery confirmed and verified a precise strike on a US Patriot air defense system in Erbil, Iraq. Fires broke out at the targeted site following the strike.
American aggression targeted the Sirik area in southern Iran. Explosions also reported in Khuzestan Province, Behbahan, and Shahroud in Semnan Province.
US disabled an Iranian LNG tanker in the Sea of Oman that was attempting to break the blockade. Two US missiles struck the vessel, martyring 2 crew members. Ship left disabled.

Iranian Fateh-110 short-range ballistic missile directly hit the US Fifth Fleet headquarters in Bahrain. Video captured the missile striking its target. Smoke columns rising from the American base in Juffair. Patriot interceptor malfunctioned and fell inside Bahraini territory.
Satellite images show Al Dhafra Air Base in UAE now completely empty. Five US aircraft visible on July 21; all withdrawn. Matches pattern at Al Udeid Air Base in Qatar.

Yemeni Ansar Allah forces targeted Saudi vessel NCC MASA in the Red Sea. Direct hits to hull. Saudi Arabia retaliated with airstrikes on Hodeidah port, fuel storage tanks, and communications facilities. Kamaran Island also struck.
Satellite imagery reveals new attack on Muwaffaq Salti Air Base, Jordan. Iran targeted AN/TPY-2 radar and Patriot system. Strike on newly built area of base.
Two explosions reported from near Bushehr, Iran. Possible US strikes on IRGC facilities.
IRIAF F-14 Tomcats on patrol over Iran-Iraq border. MiG-29s reported covering major cities. Large formation of fighter jets over Jordan simultaneously.
American C-17 transport aircraft en route to Ovda Airbase, southern Israel. Possible resupply or troop movement.
Two US refueling aircraft took off from Ben Gurion heading toward Persian Gulf. Five total refueling aircraft deploying east.
3 massive explosions in Bahrain. Iranian ballistic missiles and drones hitting targets. PAC-3 interceptor malfunction, confused missile defenses.
Large formation of US fighter jets over Jordan. E-11 BACN aircraft positioning from Prince Sultan Air Base.
Trump admin warned Iraqi Kurdistan: join war against Iran or lose autonomous status. Kurdish separatist groups seeking US weapons and explosives.
